text: Second message I've sent. Still nobody's got back to me. My granddaughter, 6, has a temperature of 38.7. She was sick once around teatime but she's kept water and juice down fine since then. What bothers me is her neck. She won't put her chin down. I asked her to look at her belly button and she just wouldn't do it, says it hurts. She keeps her head up stiff. I'd appreciate someone actually ringing me.
